highlights: walking distance to schools and amenities
summary: A spacious and well maintained four-bedroom link terraced home, ideally situated in a sought after residential location of Middleton St George, close to local amenities, schools and excellent transport links.
description:
LOUNGE A spacious and inviting living room featuring a double glazed window to the front elevation, allowing plenty of natural light to fill the space. The room offers ample space for a range of seating arrangements and flows seamlessly into the open plan dining and kitchen area, creating an ideal layout for modern family living and entertaining.

KITCHEN/DINER A stylish and contemporary kitchen dining area fitted with a newly installed range of white high gloss wall and base units, offering ample storage and worktop space. The kitchen is equipped with an integrated dishwasher, plumbing for a washing machine, a stainless steel sink with drainer and mixer tap, and an extractor hood. There is space for additional appliances as required. The dining area provides ample room for a family dining table, creating an ideal space for everyday meals and entertaining guests. The open plan layout and modern finish combine to create a bright and functional heart of the home.

SUN ROOM A bright and practical sun room situated to the rear of the property, providing direct access to the rear garden

MASTER BEDROOM A spacious double bedroom situated to the rear of the property, offering a peaceful outlook. Benefiting from fitted wardrobes providing excellent storage solutions, the room also offers ample space for additional bedroom furniture.

ENSUITE A modern en-suite fitted with a shower cubicle, wash hand basin and low level WC, offering a practical and private addition to the master bedroom.

BEDROOM Second spacious double bedroom situated to the rear of the property, featuring a useful built in storage cupboard and generous floor space for additional furnishings.

BEDROOM A generously sized double bedroom positioned to the front of the property, benefiting from a double glazed window that provides excellent natural light.

BEDROOM This well proportioned third bedroom is ideal for family members, guests or as a versatile home office.

EXTERNALLY To the front, the property benefits from off street parking accessed via the front of the property. Attractive iron gates separate the garden area, providing both convenience and privacy.
